course_outline_concepts: Toolformer (Schick 2023): self-supervised API annotation via perplexity-delta filter Δ = -log P(y|prompt+API) + log P(y|prompt), threshold τ ≈ 1.0
ToolLLM: ToolBench 16K APIs + DFS-DT trajectory synthesis — search + backtrack beats ReACT at matched budget
xLAM + APIGen (Salesforce): 3-layer verification (format / execution / semantic); ~40% rejection → 60K gold examples → xLAM-7B #1 on BFCL <13B
APIGen-MT (2025) + ToolACE: blueprint-then-rollout for multi-turn function-call synthesis; verifiability locked in before realism
BFCL leaderboard: ability-axis scoring (simple/parallel/multiple/relevance/multi-turn) shapes data targets — xLAM / Hammer / NexusRaven each optimize a different axis

sources.what_to_extract: Self-supervised API annotation pipeline; 5% API-start probability threshold; perplexity-delta filter with default τ=1.0; comparison against both no-call and call-without-result baselines; why this is the annotation-bootstrap precursor to modern pipelines.

ToolBench: 16,464 real REST APIs, 126K instances, 469K API calls; G1/G2/G3 × I1/I2/I3 taxonomy; DFS-DT trajectory synthesis with backtracking vs brittle ReACT; real-substrate-synthetic-supervision split; ToolEval 87.1% agreement with humans.

3-layer verification (format → execution → semantic); 3,673 executable APIs; 60K gold samples; ~40% rejection; ablation: remove semantic -6%, execution -11%, format -18% on BFCL-V1; MinHash dedup on (query, call); four data types simple/multiple/parallel/parallel-multiple.

Blueprint-then-rollout two-phase pipeline for multi-turn; POMDP + directed-graph API model; committee review + reverse task recombination; simulated user + agent + rejection sampling; ~12-turn average; 70% task-collection success; xLAM-2-8B 69.25% BFCL-V3 multi-turn.

Tool Self-Evolution Synthesis (26,507 APIs from 3K seed); Multi-Agent Interactive Dialog with complexity controller (5 difficulty levels); dual-layer verification (rule-based + model-based); ToolACE-8B 91.41% BFCL-V1 matching GPT-4.

xLAM family (1B / 7B / 8×7B / 8×22B / 70B); staged recipe APIGen-60k SFT → APIGen-MT SFT → optional DPO; β=0.1 preference pairs; 40/60 FC-vs-chat mix; xLAM-2-70B leading open model on τ-bench and BFCL-V3.

7 scoring categories (simple/parallel/multiple/parallel-multiple/relevance/multi-turn/multi-step); AST matcher with kwarg-order + literal canonicalization; Live V2 real user data; V3 multi-turn state mutation; pass^k consistency metric from V4; benchmark-as-training-target dynamic.

Function-name masking (30% samples replace real names with func_[a-z0-9]{6}); irrelevance augmentation (~30% negative samples); naming-bias disentangled from lexical shortcut; Hammer-7B BFCL-V2 relevance ~90%; 30% masking ratio is authors' empirical optimum.

Nested-call training (f(g(x)) composition); curriculum simple → parallel → nested; 60/20/20 mix; ~100K examples from Python stdlib + cybersecurity APIs; ablation: removing nested → −15 on nested-eval track.

Retriever-aware fine-tuning; 16K instruction-API pairs from TorchHub+TensorHub+HuggingFace; 80% noisy-retrieval + 20% oracle; hallucination 11% vs GPT-4's 40%; condition-on-doc teaches transfer to new APIs.

Three ability axes (Call / Retrieve+Call / Plan+Retrieve+Call); Lynx dataset 1,888 dialogs from multi-agent User-Assistant-Tool role-play; Alpaca 18% → 66% Call accuracy with Lynx; ability-axis evaluation ancestor of BFCL.

Early open 112K-example FC dataset; <functioncall>…</functioncall> XML wrapper template that pre-dates OpenAI tool_calls JSON; schema-conformance-only filter (no execution, no judge); derivative models land ~15% hallucination vs ~5% for APIGen.

7-capability taxonomy (Nested / Parallel / Multiple / Multi-turn / Relevance / Sequencing / Slot Filling); multi-source mix (APIGen 25% + ToolLLM 20% + Glaive 15% + Nexus 10% + in-house 20% + general 10%); naive equal-mix gives 5–10 points less than tuned mix.
